name: Prowlers of the Barrens
summary: At the Crossroads, Sergra Darkthorn sends you after the savannah prowlers. Their claws will show whether you can face the Barrens' greatest beasts.

sections.title: A True Predator
sections.body: Sergra Darkthorn tests hunters who have already faced the plainstriders and zhevras. Southwest of the Crossroads, savannah prowlers vanish into the central Barrens' gold and ochre scrub. These great cats hunt instead of grazing with the herds. They wait in tall grass, then ambush their prey, and unwary travelers can fall to them.

sections.title: Predator or Prey
sections.body: Sergra warns you that prowlers know how to hunt. Read the grasses and strike before a cat leaps if you mean to claim its paws and claws. Bring back seven prowler claws to show you have the cunning and quick reflexes to survive against Kalimdor's deadliest wildlife.

sections.title: Stepping Toward the Champion
sections.body: Your fistful of claws proves you have learned to survive on the open savannah. Sergra is pleased with your martial skill and prepares a test of valor: summon and slay Echeyakee, the white lion revered as a champion among the Barrens' predators.

faq.answer: Sergra Darkthorn, an experienced orc at the Crossroads in the Barrens, assigns the hunt as one step in a traditional series of hunting rites.

faq.q: Where are the savannah prowlers located?
faq.answer: Savannah prowlers stalk the tall grasses southwest of the Crossroads, where they blend into the veldt and hunt zhevra and unsuspecting travelers.

faq.q: What trophies are required by Sergra?
faq.answer: Sergra requires seven Prowler Claws, taken from the cats in direct combat, to prove you have bested them.

faq.q: What does this hunt lead to?
faq.answer: Slaying the prowlers proves you are ready to challenge Echeyakee, the renowned white lion of the Barrens.

faq.q: Why does Sergra have travelers hunt predators?
faq.answer: Sergra's trials cull dangerous beasts that threaten the roads and test whether hunters understand the balance between predator and prey. They weed out the reckless before greater threats await.

faq.q: Are savannah prowlers dangerous to the settlement?
faq.answer: Prowlers rarely attack fortified camps like the Crossroads, but they lurk near the southern roads and prey on travelers, messengers, and pack animals.

angles.text: As a hunter, stalking savannah prowlers through tall scrub trains you to track them, spot them before they strike, and subdue aggressive cats.
As a member of the Horde, helping tame the wilds around the Crossroads keeps supply convoys safe on the routes between Durotar, Mulgore, and the southern outposts.
As a tauren, culling rogue predators honors the natural balance and protects vulnerable caravans crossing your ancestral hunting lands.
